scale: 0-10. 0-3 learning the basics, 4-5 SDE-1 level, 6-7 SDE-2 level, 8-10 senior level.

areas.name: DSA & problem solving
areas.short: Arrays, graphs, DP under time pressure
areas.bar: Optimal approach to a LeetCode medium in about 25 minutes, clean code, edge cases covered, complexity stated without prompting.

areas.name: Low-level design
areas.bar: Working, extensible class design in a 60-90 minute machine-coding round: SOLID, the right patterns, thread safety where it matters.

areas.name: System design
areas.bar: Drives a design for a common service: requirements, capacity estimate, data model, caching, queues, and consistency trade-offs.

areas.name: CS fundamentals
areas.bar: Explains indexing, transactions and isolation levels, processes vs threads, and what happens on an HTTP request, with real examples.

areas.name: Java & concurrency depth
areas.bar: Knows HashMap and ConcurrentHashMap internals, executors, CompletableFuture, memory model basics, and GC at a working level.

areas.name: Production engineering
areas.bar: Has shipped and operated services: writes tests, understands CI/CD pipelines, deploys to cloud, reads metrics and logs to debug.

areas.name: Behavioral & ownership
areas.bar: Clear STAR stories showing ownership of a feature end to end, measurable impact, handling disagreement, and helping juniors.

areas.name: AI-assisted development
areas.bar: Uses AI coding tools daily but reviews and tests their output, and can explain the code without them.
